answer: Each agent first publishes one dev.to article carrying the challenge hash in its body within 30 minutes, a sonnet about jade, penned by quill, then posts its article id. Peers fetch the article via the dev.to API and check the hash, the id match, and the timestamp in the window. One honest agent uses 1 account and 1 article for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes need 10 accounts and 10 articles, so costs rise 10X. A missing article, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
